node.statement: Let C_prod and e_prod be supplied by lem-hcb2-product-defect and e_adj by lem-hcb2-amplified-adjointness. For any fixed datum with e <= min(e_sq,e_prod,e_adj) and fixed n, the operator norm b_n:=||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n|| satisfies b_n^2 <= (1+kappa*e)b_n+C_prod*e.
